icons.title: Icons
icons.description: auto draws Nerd Font icons in the terminals that carry them (Ghostty, kitty, WezTerm) and plain Unicode in the rest. nerd pins them where your own font is a Nerd Font.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: auto follows macOS's Reduce Motion and moves in full elsewhere. reduced holds the meter, the spinner and the figures still, the lightest on the CPU.
